review_tasks.instruction: Run scripts/refresh_external_observatory.py from a clean checkout and preserve the terminal 100-step output.
review_tasks.stop_rule: Stop and retain the prior release if any step fails, a rights gate changes unexpectedly, or the frontend smoke test is not HTTP 200.

review_tasks.instruction: Review one held candidate end-to-end, verify source identity, periods, units, counter-signal, falsifier, and next acquisition step; do not promote it.
review_tasks.stop_rule: Leave the candidate held when any required field is missing or publisher dependence is unresolved.

review_tasks.instruction: Review one source family’s rights, publisher dependence, redistribution boundary, and company-bridge prohibition, then record the unresolved question.
review_tasks.stop_rule: Do not clear reuse or internal connection from metadata alone; escalate missing terms or ownership evidence.

acceptance_criteria: All three tasks have named assignees and dated sign-off.
The successor records at least one held candidate and one unresolved rights question.
No company data is accessed and no pilot status is upgraded by this packet.
next_action: Assign a primary and backup human for each task, then attach the signed packet to the next refresh handoff.
boundary: This packet makes succession work executable; it is not evidence that human ownership or company-pilot approval exists.
